Name: JP's Starter Slime Hutch - Slime Rancher
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Starter Slime Hutch[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]

[color=#ff00ff][size=5][b][i]Because there's nothing cuter than slimy slimes that attack you at the first opportunity and leave slime everywhere... What a beautiful and sticky miracle of nature. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]This mod allows you to generate Slime Hutches when starting a new game, as well as choose the number and types of Slimes you want inside them! It also works in saved games and custom maps. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=3]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]You can create up to 10 Slime Hutches. At the start of the day, a random location with space free of obstacles will be chosen to place the buildings. If the buildings cannot be created, you will be notified of the lack of space and that you must clear the area of obstacles. The placement will be retried the following day. [/size][/font]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]For Slimes, you can choose from 12 different colors between common Slimes and Big Slimes. You can also place Tiger Slimes. You can also choose how many of each you want. [color=#00ffff]The maximum per building is 20 Slimes[/color], and you will always be notified of the Slimes placed. [/size][/font]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#ff0000][size=3][b]Slimes will only be created in Mod buildings.[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[/list]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=3]There is also an option to place Slimes randomly; they will fill all buildings created by the mod with all types of Slimes. [/size][/font]
[/list][/size]

[size=3][b]There's not much else to say, buildings are placed randomly on the map in areas without obstacles, so you can end up with some very strange locations. Space is guaranteed above and below buildings to avoid blockages, and they will not appear near warp points on the maps for the same reason. It works on [color=#00ffff]custom maps[/color][/b][/size]


[b][i][color=#00ff00][size=5]That's it, GMCM is very necessary in this mod in order to configure the mod according to your preferences. You will find detailed information in each option. [/size][/color][/i]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[/b][size=4][b]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.[/b]
